facts.fact: EuroMedAI says Organic Law No. 53.25, promulgated by Dahir No. 1.25.70 on 16 January 2026, names AI tools among the means of electoral offences, including a new Article 51 bis on fabricated content, with penalties of 2 to 5 years and MAD 50,000-100,000.

EuroMedAI says HACA Decision No. 50-26 of 16 June 2026 prohibits broadcasting falsified or AI-generated electoral content liable to mislead the public and requires a notice on AI-generated educational content on radio and television.

EuroMedAI says HACA, the audiovisual authority, adopted Decision No. 50-26 on AI-generated electoral content on radio and television, and the CNDP issued guidance in late August 2026 asking that AI-produced content be identified.
